title: Detection signatures
description: Safe fingerprints of technologies, CMSs, admin panels and staging environments, matched on every scan.
intro: A signature recognises something on a service from what the scanner already fetched: a header, a cookie name, the page title or HTML, the favicon hash, a banner, or how a path such as /admin answers. Paths are only requested with GET, never logged into. Built-in signatures can be switched off or duplicated; your own can be edited. Matches show on hosts in every scan, in the reports and on the dashboard.
deleteDescription: Delete “{{name}}”? Its matches disappear from every scan.

targetHints.header: A response header of any HTTP page of the service. Names are compared in lowercase.
targetHints.cookie: The name of a cookie the page sets. The scanner never keeps cookie values.
targetHints.title: The title of the page.
targetHints.body: The page's HTML (its first 256 KiB), e.g. a script path or the version in the footer.
targetHints.favicon: The MurmurHash3 of the favicon, as Shodan writes it (http.favicon.hash).
targetHints.probe: How a path answers a plain GET: status code, and optionally title. The scanner requests it from the next scan on; it never follows redirects or logs in.
targetHints.banner: What a non-HTTP service sends first (SSH, FTP, SMTP).
targetHints.port: Limits the other conditions to these ports; never enough on its own.

match.all: All conditions (HTTP ones on the same page)

actions.builtInReadOnly: Built-in: duplicate it to change it

toast.created: Signature created and checked against the newest scan

form.description: Describe what to look for in what the scanner already fetched. Saving checks the newest scan at once and the older ones in the background.
form.name: Name
form.productHint: Optional: the technologies report lists it under this name.
form.ratingHint: With a severity, a match is also a finding. Confidence is the least a match gets; matching on two kinds of evidence raises it.
form.headerValueHint: Leave empty: the header being there is enough.
form.versionHint: Optional RE2 pattern with one group, e.g. WordPress (\d[\d.]*). It reads the version, it does not decide the match.
form.needsCondition: Add a condition other than a port.
form.safety: Signatures only detect. They never send logins, form data or payloads, and regular expressions run in linear time.
